description: This file defines the implementation of the QhullUser class, which provides a user-defined interface for the Qhull computational geometry library. It includes constructors, destructors, methods for managing internal state, and a custom printf function for output handling.

classes.name: QhullUser
classes.description: A class representing a user-defined interface to the Qhull library, managing output and internal state.

methods.name: QhullUser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the QhullUser object with a QhullQh pointer.

methods.name: ~QhullUser
methods.description: Destructor that disables capture and restores previous user state.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets internal vectors and counters, retaining the QhullQh and previous user references.

methods.name: captureOff
methods.description: Disables user capture, with error checking.

methods.name: captureOn
methods.description: Enables user capture, with error checking.
